meals.title: Turkey, vegetables and rice
meals.portion_notes: Half a dinner for two: cooked ground turkey (about 125 g estimated), bok choy, one king oyster mushroom, one egg, rice and oil. Half a cup rice assumed dry for the whole recipe; user share one-quarter cup dry. Two tablespoons oil total; user share one tablespoon. Turkey weight and fat percentage uncertain. If rice was measured cooked, this share would be about 120 kcal lower.
meals.estimate_note: Nutrition is approximate; label-based for shakes, visual estimates for mixed meals.

workouts.title: Doubles-style stations and 4 km run
workouts.description: Sled pull, sled push, wall balls and burpees, sharing the station work roughly half with a partner at reported Pro weight, then a 4 km run.
workouts.notes: Exact station volumes, loads and session duration unknown. This is not a claim of completing the full eight-station race course.

workouts.title: Wall balls, lunges, row and run
workouts.description: 100 wall balls with a 12 lb ball, 100 weighted lunges at 55 lb, a 2 km row at reported maximum resistance, and a 2 mile run.
workouts.notes: 45 minutes including rests. Date assumed to be the local reporting day. Lunges interpreted as 100 repetitions; total versus per-leg and equipment unspecified. Row resistance is user-described, not a numeric drag factor.
